cases.name: depth-positive
cases.tradeoff: L2 recognizes an attributed Redis client factory; current facts cannot bind pipeline creation, execution, and expiry to the same client, so L3 is withheld.

cases.name: one-required-signal-missing
cases.tradeoff: One required high-precision signal is absent; the depth rule must fail closed.

cases.name: unrelated-object-methods

files.src/cache.py:
from redis import Redis
class FakeCache:
    def from_url(self, value): return self
client = FakeCache()
client.from_url('redis://cache')

cases.tradeoff: A same-named method on an unrelated local object must not count as the Redis client factory.
